verdict.rationale: Kong ships a dedicated AI Semantic Cache plugin explicitly designed to cache LLM responses at the gateway, and separate docs confirm gateway-level semantic caching to reduce redundant calls and improve latency/cost. This is first-party documentation with a named product feature, though no independent benchmark or hands-on cost/latency measurement is provided. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of actual cost/latency savings, and exact-match (non-semantic) cache configuration details.
